title: Toolbar
description: Sticky floating toolbar for surfacing persistent actions at the bottom of a scrollable area.

c.v: Sticky floating toolbar with a shared border and connected buttons. Place buttons directly inside the toolbar. Adjacent button edges are square. Exposed edges keep each button's design-system radius. A single button keeps all its corners. A separator starts a new connected group. Button themes, disabled states, and focus rings are preserved. The toolbar is not a menubar and adds no menu navigation.

rows.v: Scrolling-context root; accepted but unused, reserved for future use.
